rules.description: A tip that has been in another liquid touches the liquid of a stock (a well that held liquid from the start and that the protocol draws from). Error if the stock is drawn from again and the trace reaches wells it was never meant for; warning otherwise.
rules.title: A used tip went into a stock

sources.name: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
WHO: dos and don'ts for molecular testing

rules.description: A tip that has been in a liquid touches the liquid of a well into which the protocol never transfers that liquid on purpose, before or after. Warning.
rules.title: A used tip carried liquid into wells it was never meant for

sources.name: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling

rules.description: A well that holds liquid receives a different liquid, and liquid is later drawn out of it with no mixing of that well in between. Warning.
rules.title: Liquid drawn from a well that was not mixed after an addition

sources.name: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
Svec et al. 2015: how good is a PCR efficiency estimate

rules.description: A run of mixing strokes that cannot mix the well. A mix counts only if the strokes together move about two wells' worth of liquid (the number is in the rulebook), there are at least three of them, and no stroke is the whole well. Warning. Silent on a well of unknown volume, a well holding one liquid (a pre-wet), a stock only drawn from, and a single stroke followed by a draw from the same well (a prime). When the well holds more than the pipette can draw, the strokes are measured against the pipette instead, and a pipette that cannot draw a fifth of the well fires whatever the count.
rules.title: A mix that cannot mix the well

sources.name: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
Integra: three serial-dilution protocols (over 80% of the volume, five times)
Beckman AMPure XP instructions (mix with a tip volume just below the well volume)
Esca Automation: serial dilution, a classic technique
labautomation.io 3654: how to mix a bacteria sample enough
Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error

rules.description: An aspirate below the pipette's minimum volume is an error: the amount cannot be measured, and the simulator does not notice.
rules.title: Volume outside the pipette's range

sources.name: Opentrons: pipette characteristics (volume ranges)
Integra: pipetting tips (work at 35 to 100% of nominal volume)

rules.description: A dispense takes a well past its rim, by the labware definition's shape: error. Past the maker's stated maximum but under the rim, or where no rim is known: warning. Mixing in a well 90% full or more: warning. Declaring that a well starts with more liquid than it holds: note. Waste and trash labware, and reservoirs, tubes, beakers, bottles, troughs or containers only ever poured into, are exempt (a plate never is). When a pause comes between the well's last draw and the crossing, the finding says so.
rules.title: More liquid than the well holds

sources.name: Opentrons labware schema 2: totalLiquidVolume, the total well volume in microlitres
Bartley et al. 2023, LabOP: a protocol never adds more liquid than its container holds

rules.description: An aspirate whose tip is above the liquid in a well of known shape draws air: every well filled from it is short. The simulator does not notice.
rules.title: The source is too shallow for the tip

sources.name: Opentrons: liquid control (aspirates 1 mm above the bottom of the well by default)
Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
Gilson guide to pipetting (immersion depth 2 to 3 mm for 1 to 100 ul)
labautomation.io 7592: negative controls positive after aspirating air
Integra: 260 ul dead volume in a standard reservoir

rules.description: Labware sits on a temperature module, and liquid is drawn from or put into it before the protocol ever sets the module's temperature: the block is at room temperature until it is set. Warning, once per labware; if a cold setting (10 C or below) comes later, the finding says at which line. A module used first and then set warm is a planned incubation and is left alone, as are thermocyclers, heater-shakers and untouched labware.
rules.title: A temperature module was loaded but never set

sources.name: Opentrons, temperature module: at room temperature until set_temperature, which blocks
Thermo Fisher T4 ligase manual: keep on ice, use within minutes
NEB: Q5 High-Fidelity PCR kit manual (add the polymerase last)

rules.description: At the end of the run a well holds two or more different liquids, the last one added was under 30% of the well, and nothing mixed the well or drew from it afterwards. Note when the well holds a PCR liquid (the plate is vortexed before cycling); otherwise warning when the liquid added last is a sample, note if not. Silent on waste and trash, and on a reservoir channel only ever poured into.
rules.title: A well was never mixed after its last addition

sources.name: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
Illumina: normalising library concentrations (pipette up and down 10 times to mix)
Thermo PowerTrack user guide (a reaction plate not mixed well gives variable replicates)
Integra: how to perform serial dilutions

rules.description: A PCR or qPCR plate has no well with the mix and no sample: note. The plate counts as a PCR plate when a master mix or polymerase and samples end up together in at least four wells. A dilution series of one sample has no well of diluent without sample: note. A reverse transcriptase reaches the reaction wells and no well has the same contents without it: note. Silent when no liquids are declared, and under four reaction wells.
rules.title: No negative control

sources.name: MIQE 2009: a no-template control on every plate is essential
MIQE 2.0 (2025): the no-template and no-RT controls, still essential
Bustin 2025: MIQE compliance remains patchy

Bio-Rad real-time PCR applications guide: controls in triplicate
Thermo Maxima SYBR manual: the NTC contains all components except template DNA

rules.description: A well receives an enzyme, polymerase or master mix straight from its stock, and water or buffer comes afterwards, when the well held less than 50% of its final water or buffer at the time. Warning. Silent when no liquids are declared, when the liquid arrives inside a mix made in another tube, or when the mix is itself the bulk of the reaction.
rules.title: An enzyme was added before the water

rules.description: A tip that has been in a sample touches the liquid of a well holding a reagent into which the protocol never transfers that liquid on purpose. Warning. Proposed by example: reported as a note until adopted.
